name: sound-effect
description: Import an SFX audio file: copy under Assets/Audio/SFX/ preserving the source extension (.wav/.ogg/.mp3), hand-author the AudioImporter .meta (no Unity needed), register the clip as an SfxEntry in SoundConfig.asset, and append a row to the SFX catalog.

arguments.name: name
arguments.help: Sound id (e.g. sfx_explosion). Used as soundId and filename stem.

arguments.name: pitch-min
arguments.help: Lower bound of the random pitch range (0.8-1.2)

arguments.name: pitch-max
arguments.help: Upper bound of the random pitch range (0.8-1.2)

arguments.name: cooldown
arguments.help: Minimum seconds between retriggers of this sound
